name.description: Package name used as the tool namespace prefix.

runtime.description: Execution runtime for the tool's TypeScript code.

additionalTypeScriptGlobs.description: Extra glob patterns for TypeScript files to include beyond tool entries.

executables.description: Map of binary name to WASM file path for WASM-based tools.

tools.description: Tool definitions. Each tool has an entry TypeScript file.

entry_ts.description: Path to the tool's TypeScript entry file, relative to the package root.

accessMode.description: Data access level. readOnly: no side effects (e.g. list, get, search). reversible: creates data that can be undone (e.g. create draft, add tag). irreversible: may edit or delete data, or cause irreversible side effects (e.g. send message, update record, delete).

idempotent.description: Whether calling this tool multiple times with the same input produces the same result.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the tool does.

paramsSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input parameters.
